title: Director of Proposal Management
job_description:
Immediate Opening in Rockville, MD

Founded in 1990, CTI is a Federal Government contractor that specializes in providing print and data management services for DoD and Federal Civilian agencies.

Scope of Work:

We are seeking an experienced Director of Proposal Management to lead and actively participate in CTI’s Federal Government proposal development process. This hands-on role is responsible for managing the complete proposal lifecycle while serving as an active proposal writer, content developer, pricing contributor, and quality-control lead. The Director will work closely with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Operations, Contracts, Finance, and technical subject matter experts to develop compliant, accurate, competitive, and timely responses. A critical responsibility is maintaining a strong working knowledge of standard CTI solutions, identifying early when solicitation requirements, proposed solutions, pricing approaches, or existing content do not align with CTI’s capabilities, and continuously developing and improving CTI’s proposal database, templates, pricing resources, past performance library, and other reusable proposal assets.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Leadership & Strategy:

Develop and execute a comprehensive proposal management strategy that aligns with the company’s growth objectives
Work closely with the VP of Sales, Business Development, and Capture teams to identify and prioritize high-value opportunities and ensure alignment of proposal efforts.

Proposal Development & Management:

Oversee the entire proposal lifecycle, from bid/no-bid decision through submission and post-submission activities, ensuring on-time delivery of high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals.
Manage the proposal development process, including content creation, proposal writing, editing, reviews, and final production, ensuring that each proposal meets the requirements outlined in the solicitation.
Serve as an active proposal writer and contributor, developing, tailoring, editing, and integrating technical, management, past performance, corporate, and pricing content rather than functioning solely as a proposal coordinator.
Lead proposal kick-off meetings, daily stand-ups, and color review sessions to ensure that proposal teams stay on track with deadlines and deliverables.

Content & Quality Control:

Develop and maintain a library of proposal content, templates, and past performance narratives to streamline the proposal creation process.
Own, maintain, and continuously improve CTI’s proposal database and reusable resources, including technical responses, management approaches, past performance, resumes, corporate information, security responses, product information, pricing resources, templates, compliance language, and reusable graphics.
Ensure reusable content is current, accurate, validated, easily searchable, and consistent with CTI’s actual capabilities; identify recurring requirements where stronger reusable content is needed and proactively develop it.
Establish content ownership, version control, review dates, and standards so the proposal database functions as an active proposal-development resource rather than an archive.
Ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality of all proposal documents, including technical narratives, pricing models, and compliance matrices.
Implement a rigorous proposal review process to ensure that all submissions are thoroughly reviewed for compliance, accuracy, and overall quality.

CTI Solution Knowledge & Early Gap Identification:

Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of CTI’s standard solutions, OEM products, service delivery model, security capabilities, contract vehicles, pricing approaches, and past performance.
Evaluate solicitation requirements against CTI’s standard capabilities and identify early when a requirement, proposed solution, pricing approach, or response does not align with CTI’s capabilities or established offering.
Escalate capability, compliance, technical, contractual, pricing, or content gaps early enough for leadership and the proposal team to determine the appropriate response.
Work with subject matter experts and leadership to close identified gaps or clearly document exceptions, assumptions, dependencies, and risks.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Collaborate with technical, operations, and subject matter experts to gather the necessary information and tailor responses to meet client requirements.
Work closely with Contracts, Finance, and Pricing teams to ensure alignment of proposal strategies with pricing models and compliance requirements.
Actively support and develop pricing proposals, including pricing workbooks, CLIN structures, equipment and service pricing, labor assumptions, escalation, lease/maintenance models, and supporting price-volume information.
Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Contracts, OEMs, distributors, and partners to validate pricing inputs and ensure the technical solution, pricing assumptions, and proposal narrative remain aligned.
Coordinate with marketing and sales teams to integrate branding and messaging into proposals, ensuring consistency across all client-facing materials.

Performance Metrics & Improvement

Track and analyze key metrics such as win rate, proposal volume, and bid competitiveness, providing regular updates and insights to leadership.
Conduct post-submission debriefs and lessons learned sessions to continuously improve proposal processes and strategies.
Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposal development process.
Identify gaps, duplication, outdated content, inefficient workflows, and missing proposal resources, and implement improvements to templates, checklists, compliance tools, pricing resources, review processes, and standard operating procedures.
Capture lessons learned, successful proposal language, customer feedback, and updated solution information and incorporate them into CTI’s proposal database and future proposal processes.

Qualifications and Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, English, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
Experience: 12+ years of experience in proposal management within the federal contracting space, with a focus on civilian and/or defense sector contracts.
Solution Knowledge: Demonstrated ability to quickly develop a strong understanding of company solutions, identify requirement/capability gaps early, and translate technical and operational capabilities into accurate proposal content.
Shipley Training: Shipley-certified or equivalent training in proposal management, capture planning, or business development is highly preferred.
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in managing complex proposals for federal agencies, with a strong win rate and familiarity with FAR/DFARS regulations.
Project Management: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple proposals simultaneously under tight deadlines.
Communication Skills: Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with an eye for detail and the ability to translate complex technical content into clear, persuasive narratives.
Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop a team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
Tools & Software: Proficiency in proposal management software (e.g., Microsoft Word, SharePoint, CRM tools, Adobe Acrobat) and familiarity with collaboration platforms.
Must be a United States citizen or permanent resident with a valid work permit.

Salary and Company Benefits

Aggressive compensation and performance incentive package
Low-cost comprehensive health insurance: CTI pays 50% of the monthly premium and many of your health insurance deductible costs.
Comprehensive 401k offering including low-cost mutual funds.
CTI contributes an amount equal to 3% of your salary to your 401k regardless of whether you contribute.
Company-paid life insurance for each employee to the beneficiary of the employee’s choice.
Remote work environment.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

401(k)
Dental insurance
Employee assistance program
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Referral program
Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

How many years of Proposal Management experience do you have, specifically within federal contracting space?

Work Location: Remote
